summary.intent: Work through pending todos: wire CTR encryption into SDK uploadFile for media uploads, debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging, and fix the release gate not detecting successful desktop E2E test runs.
summary.outcome: Shipped three PRs: CTR encryption wiring in SDK with centralized MIME type list in sdk-core (PR #399), new PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint plus load test fixes (PR #400), and a simplified release gate that searches desktop-e2e.yml runs directly instead of via ci-e2e.yml orchestrator (PR #401). All merged to main.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() existed only in apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — it was never called for new SDK uploads, only for the duplicate-file re-encrypt path. CTR streaming never activated for newly uploaded files.
setByoStatus() was a dead service method in the vault module with no controller endpoint — the BYO toggle was never actually wired up, so register-cid always returned 403 not 400 as suspected.

The release gate searched ci-e2e.yml orchestrator runs for desktop E2E results, but successful desktop E2E tests ran as standalone desktop-e2e.yml workflow runs. The orchestrator's desktop jobs were skipped via per-commit change detection.

pnpm api:generate lint step was scanning target/ (Rust build artifacts and rustdoc JS) producing 261 spurious ESLint errors. target/ was not in eslint.config.js ignores (only **/src-tauri/target/** was).
API spec generation (openapi:generate) requires the API server to be running — it generates from a live NestJS app, not from source. Running it against an old build produces a stale spec.
Multiple API test files used jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> then re-fetched the service via module.get(), losing mock method types. Pattern was systemic across republish, tee, shares, vault test files.
gh run list returns runs by creation time, not commit order — a re-triggered run for an older commit can appear before a newer commit's run in results.
Both .planning/todos/done/ and .planning/todos/pending/ ended up with copies of the sdk-uploadfile-hardcodes-gcm todo after the PR #399 merge brought both into main simultaneously.

code.finding: New centralized module for CTR vs GCM selection: STREAMING_MIME_TYPES allowlist, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD (256KB), selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size), normalizeEncryptionMode(). Both sdk/client.ts and apps/web now import from here.
Added optional encryptionMode param. When 'CTR': uses encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv instead of GCM. Passes mode through to createFileMetadata.
uploadFile now calls selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) to determine CTR vs GCM before delegating to sdkCore.uploadFile.
New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint using SetByoStatusDto and SetByoStatusResponseDto. Calls vaultService.setByoStatus() which previously had no controller wiring.
createByoClientPool now enables BYO mode on each account via PATCH /vault/byo-status after pool creation, and filters out accounts where enable fails. Throws if zero accounts succeed.

createSdkContext was being called inside the upload loop — hoisted outside. ipns-publish was sending {ipnsName, cid} but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires a signed record; replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core.

Desktop E2E gate rewritten to search desktop-e2e.yml runs directly by iterating commits in range newest-first, matching against runs by headSha. Handles in-flight runs and re-triggered runs correctly. Previous approach searched ci-e2e.yml orchestrator which skipped desktop jobs via change detection.

Pre-existing: used module.get() to fetch services typed as jest.Mocked<Partial<T>>, then called .mockResolvedValue() on them — TypeScript loses mock methods after module.get() return type. Fix: use the mock objects directly without re-fetching from module.

workflow: When fixing pre-existing test errors alongside feature work, proactively update .learnings/ and CONVENTIONS.md so the pattern isn't repeated — the jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> anti-pattern affected 9 files.
gh api graphql times out occasionally on this repo — falling back to gh api (REST) for PR comment fetching is reliable.
Committing only specific files during api:generate can miss new generated files/directories that orval creates — always stage the full packages/api-client/src/ directory after regeneration.
When accidental files appear in a PR diff (e.g., apps/api/openapi.json written to wrong path), remove them with git rm --cached + commit rather than reverting.
.git/info/exclude is the right place for tool-generated files that modify tracked files locally (e.g., Entire CLI's husky hooks) — keeps them out of git status without affecting other contributors.

friction: The merge of PR #399 into main brought both pending/ and done/ copies of the sdk-uploadfile todo — the git history had both states and both landed in the fast-forward.
api:generate runs lint as its final step, which was hitting 261 errors in Rust target/ artifacts — blocked clean generation feedback until eslint.config.js was fixed.
API spec generation requires a running API server; the locally running server was an old build without the new endpoint, producing a stale spec that missed the new byo-status models.
gh api graphql repeatedly timed out during review thread resolution, requiring fallback to REST API.
The pre-existing jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern across 9 API test files required significant test cleanup unrelated to the feature being implemented.
Push operations appeared to hang (no output) but had actually completed — multiple redundant push attempts and wait loops were triggered.

The release gate bug required three rounds of iteration: (1) fixing stop-at-first-failure, (2) discovering the real issue was wrong workflow file entirely, (3) rewriting to search desktop-e2e.yml directly.
.husky/commit-msg was modified by Entire CLI locally and kept appearing in git status — required adding to .git/info/exclude after accidentally committing both the wrapper and the pre-entire hook.
